newsitem.title: UK: Medisys seeks U.S. syringe system approval.
newsitem.headline: Medisys seeks U.S. syringe system approval.

text.p: Newly-formed British medical equipment company Medisys Plc said on Wednesday it was seeking U.S. regulatory approval for a machine which allows immediate destruction of hypodermic needles after use.
In a statement Medisys said it expected the approval process to be completed before the end of the year, allowing it to put the product on sale.

The Medisys system, NiC1800, has been developed to allow hospitals and doctors to dispose of needles immediately and safely, incinerating them on site and storing the waste in a sealed cartridge. Portable systems and a device for use at home are also being developed.
Medisys said there were around one million needlestick injuries caused by used syringes in the U.S. every year.
The system is already on sale in Europe, Asia and Mexico.
The needle disposal system was developed by the privately-owned Needle Incinerator Company, which was acquired by Biocure Plc in a reverse takeover last month.
The combined group adopted the name Medisys and began trading on London's Alternative Investment market (AIM) last week. The stock was unchanged at 15 1/2 pence in midmorning trade.
